name: Projects Manager
tagline: Runs a team of Grok bots as a project org, with Notion as the source of truth
description: Spins up a coder, designer, researcher and writer as separate bots, gives each project its own Notion row and channel, and lets the specialists claim tasks off a shared board.

source.excerpt: Shared as a projects manager built on a team of Grok bots, with Notion holding the projects and tasks.

body:
## What it does

Spins up a coder, designer, researcher and writer as separate bots, gives each project its own Notion row and channel, and lets the specialists claim tasks off a shared board. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer. It is built as a team of bots rather than a single one, so the roles stay separate.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @ericzakariasson shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
